title: Cosmic Skull Portal
description: A large black human skull with glowing pink eyes dominates the upper left, its mouth open as a swirling vortex of vibrant pink, purple, yellow, and orange smoke pours out. Below it sits a transparent glass dome containing four skeletons in various poses, one holding a beetle, surrounded by glowing orbs on dark rocky ground.
prompt: Surreal dark scene featuring a giant black skull with glowing pink eyes in the upper left, its mouth emitting a swirling colorful vortex of magenta, purple, yellow and orange smoke and particles.
